description:
Stop compromising on performance. Our 1000W powerhouse delivers instant acceleration that gets you up to 28 MPH in seconds. Whether you're dodging city traffic or tackling steep 30° hills, this motor maintains consistent torque so you never feel underpowered. It’s not just a ride; it’s a beast.

Leave range anxiety in the rearview mirror. Powered by a high-capacity 48V 13Ah battery, you can clock up to 27 miles on a single charge—perfect for long-distance commutes or weekend explorations. Plus, with our 4-6 hour fast-charging tech, you’ll spend less time plugged into a wall and more time on the open road.

From smooth asphalt to gritty gravel trails, our 10-inch off-road tires are built to handle it all. The deep-tread design provides superior grip and shock absorption, turning bumpy sidewalks into a cloud-like experience. Built with a reinforced carbon steel frame, this scooter is as tough as the paths you’ll explore.

Your ride, your rules. Connect via our Smart App to digitally lock your scooter, customize LED ambient lighting, and monitor your stats in real-time. Want to set the mood? Sync your phone to the built-in Bluetooth speakers and soundtrack your commute. Safety is also covered with a responsive dual-braking system for precision stopping power.

Designed for the hustle. Our quick-fold mechanism lets you collapse the scooter in just 3 seconds, making it a breeze to carry onto the subway or toss in your trunk. Backed by a 1-year comprehensive warranty and US-based customer support, we ensure your investment is protected every mile of the way.
